overall_notes: The paper focuses on evaluating reasoning trace generation (Chain-of-Thought) quality rather than traditional NLG tasks. The framework uses LLM-based classification and human evaluation to assess reasoning patterns, with cosine similarity and KL divergence as quantitative metrics. Extracted metadata was largely accurate with minor normalization needed.
